newsitem.title: UK: UK regulator to demand costs from MGAM - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK regulator to demand costs from MGAM - paper.

text.p: IMRO, the UK fund management regulator, is to demand that Morgan Grenfell Asset Management pay the two million pounds spent investigating it and its former fund manager Peter Young, the Sunday Telegraph reported.
In addition, MGAM will have to pay a record one million stg fine, the paper said.

Deutsche Bank agreed last week to pay out compensation of around 200 million pounds following irregularities in valuations of unlisted securities in some of MGAM's unit trusts. MGAM is Deutsche Bank's fund management arm.
Young was sacked by the firm and is under investigation by Britain's Serious Fraud Office. He has said he is not guilty of any criminal activity.
